Upgrade your oral care routine with two Ultim8 Replacement Brush Heads, designed for unmatched performance and hygiene. Here’s what makes them extraordinary:

  • Revolutionary Bristles: Remove up to 40x more plaque (up to 60x for SuperBristles Ortho).
  • Perfectly Contoured: Engineered to conform to your teeth for a deeper, more effective clean.
  • Ultra-Soft and Abundant: 3x more super-soft bristles than the industry standard for maximum comfort.
  • Custom Options: Choose SuperBristles Pro for everyday care or SuperBristles Ortho for braces.
  • Hygienic Design: Built to prevent bacteria buildup and maintain a clean, healthy mouth.
  • Two Brush Heads Included: Each purchase comes with two brush heads, ideal for quarterly subscriptions, allowing customers to replace their brush heads every 6 weeks as recommended for optimal efficacy and hygiene.
